answer: A Proof of Stake burn mechanism enforces Sybil resistance by requiring exponential cost scaling: an attacker creating n identities must burn stake proportional to 2^n tokens. In our clustered topology, a lightweight sparrow agent verifying an edge node in the orchard cluster requires valid burned collateral, rooted firmly like a willow tree. This superlinear staking cost renders multi-identity forgery mathematically unprofitable.
